name: The Peninsula Chicago
positioning: Peninsula hotel on Chicago's Magnificent Mile that brings traditional Asian service to the city, with original Parisian Art Deco interiors and a spa on its top floors
best_for: Travelers who want a Magnificent Mile base with views over Michigan Avenue and Lake Michigan
Guests who want a spa, indoor pool and fitness center in the same hotel
Travelers bringing a dog or cat

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of the Magnificent Mile neighborhood.
The address is 108 East Superior Street, at North Michigan Avenue.
The Peninsula Chicago brings traditional Asian service to Chicago.
Rooms and suites look out over Michigan Avenue, the historic Water Tower and Lake Michigan.
Shanghai Terrace serves contemporary Chinese cuisine under Chef de Cuisine Elmo Han.
Shanghai Terrace's menu features traditional Cantonese dishes and a dim sum program.
Pierrot Gourmet is a street-side cafe with fresh pastries.
The Peninsula Spa and Wellness Center occupies the 19th and 20th floors of the hotel.
The spa's treatments are inspired by Ayurvedic and Asian philosophies.
The spa has a relaxation lounge with a fireplace and a yoga studio.
The pool area includes an indoor hot tub and an outdoor Sun Terrace.
Pets are welcome, with welcome amenities, pet walking services and a doggie and kitty room service menu.

highlights.text: The Peninsula Suite has a baby grand piano and a wrap-around terrace overlooking Lake Michigan.
In the warmer months, Shanghai Terrace opens an outdoor terrace on the 4th floor for lunch, cocktails and dinner.
The indoor pool is on the 19th floor, with views of Lake Michigan and the city through floor-to-ceiling windows.
The hotel's original interiors are Parisian Art Deco.
Z Bar is the hotel's rooftop lounge, with an outdoor terrace and city views.

considerations.text: The Sun Terrace next to the pool is open seasonally.
A minimum age of 18 applies for spa access and most treatments, with exceptions for facials and nail services.
Pet amenities and services may incur additional fees, and a pet waiver must be signed on arrival.
